items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you ever know a pair of man by the name of Gutierrez? Arthur Gutierrez? No.

ctx.x: Steve Woodrow played with the Triangle Band, with the Majaudi. And when he died, I thought it was Sam, our name. Yeah. It's like that. But she died. I just died a couple of weeks ago, a month ago.
Did you ever know a pair of man by the name of Gutierrez? Arthur Gutierrez? No. There was a name in here that I was playing.
Did you know Joe Garrow? Joe Garrow, yeah. You remember that? Yes. You played with Joe Garrow. You're a banjo player. He used to play.
